drift_findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Two independent readers of 'HL entry' write the two columns: hl-sync-guardian (pos_data['entry_px']) always writes hl_entry_price and writes entry_price only when delta>0.1%; position_manager rewrites entry_price from hl_positions[coin]['entry_px'] but not hl_entry_price. With two concurrent open rows for the same coin (#17066+#17067 both open 14:28-16:04) the coin-keyed lookup can only correct one snapshot, so the columns diverge. NOT VERIFIED — writer not pinned.
